sources.label: Morphe patches for Taobao localization and language customization.
sources.author: TaobaoLingo
patch_list: TaobaoLingo: Enable English for Japan picker (experimental)
Add English in Japan to the bundled locale choices and both server-side region collections.
English ID-based and named string resources without modifying networking or regional locale (experimental).
TaobaoLingo: Extended DinamicX subclass English labels (experimental)
Translate TEXT input to 24 custom DinamicX subclass attribute handlers before independent field writes.
Exact-match English UI labels at DinamicX text binding, leaving network and account language unchanged.
TaobaoLingo: Show English in Japan locale picker (fallback)
Offer English alongside Chinese in Japan's bundled onboarding locale choices; server data may override it.
